get.description:
This poll week's FBS and FCS games of the week, for Power and Résumé (picked with
Sunday's rankings and held all week); empty before the first pick.
Game center: prediction, full odds board, market comparison, snapshot history, result.
Hypothetical game between any two teams (slugs), predicted as of now.
Current season and week, and when ratings and predictions were last updated.

Playoff odds, fair futures odds and a projected bracket (regular season only):
the College Football Playoff (`fbs`) or the 24-team FCS playoff (`fcs`).

Power (how good now) or Résumé (what they've accomplished) rankings.

`division`: fbs (default), fcs, or all. Ranks are within a division; `all` ranks FBS and
FCS together by rating (Power only: Résumé benchmarks differ by division, so 422).
